paite: Huchi in Israel suan om khawmte tengteng akisata ua, pheikhai lual in Dan a pan Beer-sheba kho pha in Gilead gam a mite toh Mizpah ah TOUPA kiang ah akikhawm uhi.
heading: Galdou Ding In Israel Akisakhol
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

paite: Mi tengteng heutu, Israel chite tengteng Pathian mite kikhopkhawmna ah atel ua, sepaih namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uhi.
english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

paite: Benjamin suante'n Israel suante Mizpah ah ahohtou uh chih aza ua, Israel suante'n, "Bangchidan a hichibang a gitlouhna hong om ahia, hon hilh un?" achi uhi.
english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”

paite: Levi chi, athah uh numei pasal in, "Benjamin chite omna Gibeah ah ka mei toh giak ding in ka va lut uhi.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

paite: Gibeah mite'n ahong sualta ua, zan in inn ahong um ua; hon thah atum ua, ka mei apawngsual ua asita hi.
english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

paite: Huchi in ka mei luang ka sem a, Israelte gam luah tengteng ah ka khak a, Israel gam ah thilkihhuai leh haihuaitak ana hihta ngal ua.
english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

paite: Nou Israel suante aw, na vek un ngai un, na ngaihdan uleh pha na sakdan uh gen dih ua," achi hi.
english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng pheikhai lual in athou ua, “Kuamah i puanin lam ah i pai het kei ding, kuamah i inn ah i lut kei ding uh.
english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

paite: Gibeahte i bawldan ding hichibang ahi. Ai i san ding ua, amaute i dou ding uh.
english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

paite: Gibeah mun a Benjaminte i va sualna ua mipite nek ding pe ding in Israel nam tengteng lak a mi zakhat ah sawmkhat zel, sangkhat ah zakhat zel, singkhat ah sangkhat zel i telkhe ding uh," achi uhi.
english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng pheikhai lual in huai khopi sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

paite: Israel namte'n Benjamin nam tengteng kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na lak ua na hih uh bang gitlouhna ahia?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

paite: Gibeah a mi Belial tate hon pi unla, Israel gam a gitlouhna adaihtheihna ding in ka na that ding uh," chi in mi asawl uhi. Himahleh Benjamin chite'n a-unau Israel suante thugen azui nuam kei uh.
english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.

paite: Benjamin suante bel Israel suante dou ding in khopite a pan ahong pawtkhawm ua, Gibeah ah alutta uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni a Benjamin suante khopi a pan namsau tawi a pawtte, Gibeah a mi zasagih telkhiakte sim louh in singnih-le-sangguk ahi uh.
english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

paite: Huai tengteng lak ah veilong zasagih, telkhiak a-om ua; amaute'n vaisuangseh in samzang chia leng akhial kei uhi.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

paite: Israel mite, Benjamin mite sim louh in namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uh. Amau tengteng galdou thei vek ahi uh.
english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

paite: Israel suante athou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, Pathian ava dong ua, Benjamin suante kua'n ahia va sual adto masa ding? achi uh.
heading: Benjaminte Douna
english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” Yahweh said, “Judah first.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Judah nam va hoh masa uhen," achi hi. Huchi in Israel suante lak ah athou ua, Gibeah khua ava umta uhi.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

paite: Israel mite Benjamin pawl sual ding in akisa ua, Israel mite'n Gibeah ah amaute sual ding in panmun akhoh uhi.
english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

paite: Benjamin suante Gibeah a pan apawtkhia ua, huai ni in Israel suante lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih ava that uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

paite: Mipite, Israel mite akihasuan nawn ua, asual tung ni ua asualna mun mah uah sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

paite: Israel suante ahohtou ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in ava kap ua, "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va sual nawn un," achi hi.
english: The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” Yahweh said, “Go up against him.”

paite: Ani nih ni in Israel suante'n Benjamin suante ava naih uhi.
english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

paite: Benjamin suante leng huai ani nih ni in sual ding in Gibeah a pan apawt sam ua, Israel suante lak a mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ahong that nawn uh. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

paite: Huchi in Israel suan tengteng leh mi tengteng ava paitou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, akap ua, TOUPA ma ah atu uhi. Huai ni in nitak tan in an angawl uh. TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA adong uh (huai hun lai in huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm a-om hi).
english: The children of Israel asked Yahweh (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

paite: Huai lai in Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in a-nna asem zel ahi. "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam, ka tawpsanta mai ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va hoh un; zingchiang in zaw na khut uah ka hon peta ding," achi hi.
english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” Yahweh said, “Go up; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand.”

paite: Israel suante'n Gibeah kho kim ah tangpang mi agukkoih uhi.
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

paite: Israel suante Benjamin suante sual ding in ani thum ni in akisa nawn uh. Nidang mah bang in Gibeah khua sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

paite: Benjamin suante bel huai mite sual ding in apawt ua, khua apawtsan uhi. Huchi in nidang mah bang in mite sual in athat pan nawnta ua, loubuk ngial ah Bethel kholam lamliante ah Israel suante sawmthum athat uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

paite: Benjamin suante'n, "Ama mah bang in i ma uah azahlak nawnta uh e," achi uhi. Israel suante'n bel, "I tai ding uh, khopi a pan lamlian lam ah i tolhkhesak ding," achi uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan tengteng in apanmun uh apawtsan ua, Baal Tamar mun ah panmun akhoh uhi. Israel suan aguk a na tangpangte amun ua pan, Gibeah Phaizang a panmun tan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

paite: Israel suante tengteng lak a telkhiak mi singkhat in ava sual ua, kidouna athupi mahmah hi. Himahleh amau thil hoih lou akiang naichik uah a-om chih athei kei uh.
english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah Benjamin suante athat hi. Israel suante'n huai ni in Benjamin suante mi singnih sangnga-le-zakhat athat uhi. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
english: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

paite: Huchi in Benjamin suante'n avuallelta uh chih ahong kitheita uhi. Israel suante'n Gibeah khua sual dia aguk a tangpang mite akoih uh amuan ziak un Benjamin suante anungtolh san uhi.
heading: Israelte Vualzohdan
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

paite: Aguk a tangpang mite'n Gibeah khua asual guih uhi. Huchi in aguk a tangpangte akiphalh ua, khua a mi tengteng namsau in asualta uhi.
english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

paite: Israel suante leh aguk a tangpang mite'n akichiam uh bel khopi sung a mei khuttouhsak ding, chih ahi.
english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

paite: Huai amuh chiang ua, Israel taikekte kilehhei a, dou ding achih uh ahi.
english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

paite: Huchi in khopi sung a meikhu ahong kitun nguingui tak in, Benjamin suante akihei uleh, ngai in, khopi apum in van lam tan ah akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante ahong kilehhei ua, Benjamin suante'n lamdang asa mahmah uh. Atan uh ahoih kei ding chih lah atheita ngal ua.
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante ma ah gamdai ah ataikekta uh. Himahleh adelhzui pek ua, khopi a pan hong pawtte'n huai ah ana that uhi.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

paite: Benjamin suante bel a-umsip ua, adelh ua, nisuahna lam Gibeah kiang a akhawlna uah aphata uhi.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

paite: Benjamin suante mi singkhat-le- sanggiat asi ua; avek un mihat hangsan chiat ahi uh.
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

paite: Akihei ua, gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah atai uh. Mi sangnga lamliante ah atom ua; Gidom tan in adelhzui ua, mi sangnih athat uhi.
english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

paite: Huchi in huai ni a Benjamin suan site, namsau tawimi ngen singnih-le-sangnga ahi ua, avek un mihat hangsan ahi uhi.
english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

paite: Mi zagukte gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah ataikek ua, huai Rimmon suangpi ah kha li sung a-om uhi.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

paite: Israel suante Benjamin suante tung ah akisa nawn ua, khopi sung a om peuhmah gante, amuhmuh uh namsau in asatlum zel ua, huai lou leng khua amuh peuhmah uh ahal zel uhi.
english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.
